name: specialist_policy_v1
status: frozen before the first specialist session
purpose: On-demand LLM specialist agents (P3). Within the existing frozen LLM limits; this file only assigns the per-session call caps to the specialist roles.
connector: inherits evals/frozen/research_policy.json llm.connectors.claude-cli (official claude CLI, no tools, one turn, no session persistence, empty temp dir)

roles.A1: Research Scout: chooses ONE fetched arXiv record and extracts a claim with a verbatim supporting quote
roles.G1: Quantitative Scientist: proposes ONE calendar/event hypothesis, citing registry test ids and the scout's source
roles.E3: Adversarial Scientist: critiques the proposal (most likely failure, rival explanations, a disconfirming test)

context_rules.G1_sees: DISCOVERY-period registry rows only (id, hypothesis, status, effect, n, BH-adjusted p) + data catalogue + the verified scout claim
context_rules.G1_never_sees: CONFIRMATION rows, forecast SCREEN/selection results, prospective outcomes, holdouts
context_rules.reason: every historical day has already been scanned; a new hypothesis chosen with confirmation results in view could only be evaluated prospectively anyway

deterministic_validation.scout: arxiv id must be one of the fetched records; quote must occur verbatim (whitespace-normalised, case-insensitive) in that record's abstract or title
deterministic_validation.quant: family/metric from the allowed lists; every cited test id must exist in the registry and be a DISCOVERY row; data_needed must be in the available catalogue; hypothesis key family:label:metric already registered -> rejected_duplicate; previously proposed key -> rejected_duplicate
deterministic_validation.accepted_proposal: status 'queued_prospective' only: never tested on historical data, never promoted; a human decides whether to register a prospective protocol

never: no status changes of existing tests
no instructions from source text are followed
